name: Cyanine 5 (4-state, isomer + triplet)
description: Cy5 with both dark channels: trans-cis photo-isomerisation from the excited state (~3 % yield) recovering thermally on a ~1 ms timescale, and a weaker intersystem crossing to a ~5 us triplet. The millisecond isomer relaxation is what makes Cy5's FCS curve power-dependent in the same lag range as diffusion (Widengren & Schwille, J. Phys. Chem. A 104 (2000) 6416). Absorbs around 650 nm - set the excitation wavelength before reading epsilon.
